clusters.deviation: No Utility | Instrument air / control power to BPCS and valves
clusters.causes: Loss of instrument air or UPS/control power
clusters.consequences: BV-400 and BV-410 fail closed and BV-160 fails open. If LCV-100/LCV-300 do not also fail closed, fuel keeps entering a blocked-in stack, overpressuring it and venting H2 at Vent Out
safeguards: BV-160 fail open to Vent Out
recommendations: Specify LCV-100 and LCV-300 as fail-closed and review the fail position of LCV-200 for a safe shutdown
Provide a UPS for the BPCS and safety system

clusters.deviation: More Flow | Vent Out (BV-160 / PSV-160)
clusters.causes: BV-160 (fail open) opens spuriously on loss of signal or utility, or PSV-160 lifts or passes
clusters.consequences: The stack depressurises suddenly and hot, possibly flammable gas is released at Vent Out. It may ignite at the vent outlet, and the pressure transient upsets the stack
safeguards: Vent routed to a dedicated Vent Out
recommendations: Confirm the vent outlet is in a safe location per class rules for hydrogen-fuelled ships, with a dispersion study
Add BV-160 position indication and an alarm

clusters.deviation: No Power | DC output
clusters.causes: DC breaker trip or load rejection by the propulsion system
clusters.consequences: The cells reach open-circuit voltage and the voltage goes high. Fuel is not consumed and flows to Anode Out, and the stack cools. The ship loses propulsion power, which in confined waters can lead to collision or grounding.
safeguards: Multiple stack modules providing partial redundancy
recommendations: Implement automatic fuel cutback on load rejection
Review propulsion redundancy and emergency power against class rules

clusters.deviation: As well as Composition | Air to cathode (sea salt / water spray)
clusters.causes: Air intake filtration fails or green water / sea spray is drawn into the air compressor intake in heavy weather
clusters.consequences: Chlorides and sodium enter the cathode. The cathode and separator plates corrode faster and the carbonate electrolyte is contaminated. Cell performance drops and stack life is shortened (economic loss).
safeguards: TE-110 / TI-110 and PIT-110 / PI-110 air inlet indication
recommendations: Provide marine-grade air intake filtration (salt/coalescing filters) with differential pressure alarm
Locate the air intake away from spray zones and exhaust/vent outlets

clusters.deviation: As well as Composition | Feed (natural gas + water) to reformer
clusters.causes: Sulphur compounds or other contaminants in the natural gas, or impurities in the water
clusters.consequences: The reforming catalyst and Ni anode are poisoned. Reforming drops off, the heat balance is upset, and stack performance degrades over time
recommendations: Confirm upstream desulphurisation and water treatment, and set periodic feed quality analysis

clusters.deviation: As well as Composition | Feed (sulphur / impurities)
clusters.causes: Desulphurisation upstream fails or the natural gas supply is off-specification
clusters.consequences: The reformer catalyst and Ni anode are poisoned. Performance degrades and stack life is shortened (economic loss).
recommendations: Provide a sulphur analyser downstream of the desulphuriser with alarm

clusters.deviation: Before Operation | Start-up fuel admission
clusters.causes: Fuel (LCV-100/LCV-300) admitted before the stack is purged and heated, due to operator error or sequence fault
clusters.consequences: Residual air and fuel form a flammable mixture inside the hot stack, leading to internal explosion and stack destruction.
recommendations: Implement start-up permissives (purge complete, stack temperature) on LCV-100/LCV-300
Provide inert gas purge system and written start-up procedure

clusters.deviation: Before Operation | Start-up sequence
clusters.causes: Feed or H2 BOG is admitted before the stack is purged and heated, or before air flow is established
clusters.consequences: A flammable mixture forms in the stack or vent and can explode. Feeding a cold reformer deposits carbon
recommendations: Add start-up permissives: completed inert purge, minimum stack temperature, and confirmed air flow before LCV-100 / LCV-300 can open

clusters.deviation: Less Composition | CO2 at cathode
clusters.causes: High share of H2 BOG relative to natural gas feed (little CO2 in anode exhaust recycled to cathode)
clusters.consequences: Carbonate ions are not regenerated, so electrolyte is depleted, cell voltage drops and performance degrades.
recommendations: Define minimum NG/BOG ratio in control philosophy, or CO2 make-up

clusters.deviation: Less Composition | Feed steam-to-carbon ratio
clusters.causes: Water pump failure/low water flow while NG flow continues (FIT-100 measures only total feed)
clusters.consequences: Carbon is deposited on the reformer catalyst and anode. This blocks gas channels, raises pressure drop, deactivates the catalyst and causes irreversible stack damage.
recommendations: Provide separate NG and water flow measurement with a low steam-to-carbon ratio alarm and trip of NG supply

clusters.deviation: Less Level | Electrolyte in stack
clusters.causes: Carbonate is gradually lost through evaporation, corrosion and creep over the operating life
clusters.consequences: The electrolyte matrix dries out and gas crosses over. Cell voltage falls and local combustion hot spots develop.
safeguards: VE-100 / VZA-100 low cell voltage alarm
recommendations: Trend cell voltage deviation for predictive stack replacement

clusters.deviation: Less Pressure | MCFC stack (external leak)
clusters.causes: Wet-seal or flange leak at 650 °C, or carbonate corrosion of the stack housing or manifolds
clusters.consequences: H2, CO and natural gas are released into the fuel cell space. Fire or explosion is possible, people can be exposed to toxic CO, and propulsion power may be lost
recommendations: Provide H2 and CO gas detection in the fuel cell space, interlocked to fuel isolation and ventilation
Enclose the stack with ventilation monitoring per IGF Code / class rules

clusters.deviation: Less Pressure | Stack anode / cathode
clusters.causes: PSV-160 lifts or passes, BV-160 opens spuriously (fail-open), or an external leak occurs
clusters.consequences: The stack depressurises and stack gas, including H2 and CO, is released to Vent Out. The anode-cathode differential is upset and gas crosses over. Flammable or toxic gas is released at the vent outlet.
safeguards: PIT-100 / PIT-110 / PIT-120 inlet pressure indication
recommendations: Add position feedback on BV-160 with an alarm
Locate Vent Out in a safe area, confirmed by a dispersion study

clusters.deviation: More Flow | Feed (natural gas + water) to reformer
clusters.causes: LCV-100 fails open or SIC-400 control fault
clusters.consequences: Excess endothermic reforming over-cools the stack and creates thermal gradients that can crack the cells. Anode pressure rises. Unreacted fuel is carried to the anode outlet, which can overheat downstream combustion equipment.
safeguards: TE-200/TE-210 and TT-410 stack temperature monitoring
recommendations: Add high feed flow alarm on FIT-100 and fuel-to-current ratio limiting in the BPCS

clusters.deviation: More Flow | Feed (natural gas + water) to reformer
clusters.causes: LCV-100 fails open or flow control fault
clusters.consequences: Excess endothermic reforming cools the stack locally (risk of electrolyte freezing at the inlet). Excess unreacted CH4/H2 goes to the anode outlet and downstream, and fuel is wasted.
recommendations: Add high feed flow alarm on FIT-100

clusters.deviation: More Pressure | Anode outlet
clusters.causes: BV-400 (fail closed) closes spuriously on loss of signal or actuator power, or the downstream line is blocked
clusters.consequences: Anode pressure rises while fuel is still supplied. High differential pressure across the electrolyte forces H2/CO into the cathode, causing combustion and hot spots. Seals can fail and release H2/CO externally (fire, explosion, CO toxicity)
recommendations: Add an anode outlet pressure transmitter with a high alarm and a trip that closes LCV-100 / LCV-300
Interlock BV-400 closure with fuel isolation
Verify that PSV-160 protects the anode side and is sized for this case

clusters.deviation: More Pressure | Anode-to-cathode differential
clusters.causes: Mismatch between fuel (LCV-100/LCV-300) and air (LCV-200) flows, or uneven throttling of BV-400 against BV-410
clusters.consequences: The electrolyte wet seal is broken and gas crosses over. H2/CO burns directly with air inside the stack, causing hot spots and cell or stack destruction. A fire may spread outside the stack.
safeguards: PIT-100 / PIT-110 / PIT-120 inlet pressure indication
TE-200/TE-210 and TT-410 stack temperature monitoring
recommendations: Install an anode-cathode differential pressure transmitter with alarm and a SIL 1 trip

clusters.deviation: More Pressure | Cathode outlet
clusters.causes: BV-410 (fail closed) closes spuriously, or the downstream line is blocked
clusters.consequences: The cathode overpressures and the differential pressure reverses, pushing air into the anode. Mixing O2 with fuel causes local combustion, damages the stack, and can break seals
recommendations: Interlock BV-410 closure with air flow reduction (LCV-200) and stack shutdown
Add a cathode outlet pressure measurement

clusters.deviation: More Pressure | Stack (blocked outlet)
clusters.causes: BV-400 or BV-410 closes spuriously (fail-closed on signal/air loss) while inlet flows continue
clusters.consequences: Stack overpressure causes wet-seal blow-out, anode/cathode gas crossover and mixing of H2/CO with air at 650 °C. This can cause internal combustion, fire or explosion and release from the stack.
recommendations: Interlock closure of BV-400/BV-410 to close LCV-100/LCV-200/LCV-300 and open BV-160
Add stack pressure transmitter with high-high pressure trip (SIL 2 assessment)
Verify PSV-160 sizing for blocked-outlet case

clusters.deviation: More Pressure | Stack anode / cathode
clusters.causes: BV-400 or BV-410 (fail-closed) closes spuriously or loses its signal/actuating air while the inlets remain open
clusters.consequences: The outlet is blocked and pressure in the stack rises. The wet seals fail and hot H2/CO-rich gas is released into the machinery space. Fire or explosion and CO toxicity can cause multiple fatalities.
safeguards: PIT-100 / PIT-110 / PIT-120 inlet pressure indication
recommendations: Install stack pressure transmitters on anode and cathode with an independent high-high pressure SIF (SIL 2) that closes LCV-100/200/300 and opens BV-160
Add position feedback on BV-400 and BV-410, interlocked with the inlet valves
Verify PSV-160 sizing for the blocked-outlet case and that it protects both anode and cathode

clusters.deviation: More Temperature | Feed / air / H2 BOG inlet
clusters.causes: Upstream heat exchanger bypass or control failure (outside this node) gives hot inlet gas
clusters.consequences: The stack inlet is overheated and thermal gradients form. Carbon can deposit at the reformer inlet from cracking of natural gas. Stack temperature rises and the stack ages faster.
safeguards: TE-100 / TI-100, TE-110 / TI-110 and TE-120 / TI-120 inlet temperature indication
TE-200/TE-210 and TT-410 stack temperature monitoring
recommendations: Add high temperature alarms on TI-100, TI-110 and TI-120

clusters.deviation: No Power | DC-Power output
clusters.causes: Sudden loss of load (propulsion trip, breaker opens), or a short circuit in the DC system
clusters.consequences: On open circuit the cell voltage rises and unconsumed fuel goes to Anode Out. Without the cell reaction heat the stack cools. A short circuit can cause arcing and damage to the electrical system, and propulsion is lost
recommendations: Cut fuel back automatically on load rejection
Confirm DC short-circuit protection and selectivity

clusters.deviation: Other than Composition | Feed (low steam-to-carbon ratio)
clusters.causes: Water pump failure or wrong water/natural gas proportion in the feed
clusters.consequences: Carbon deposits in the internal reformer and the anode. The catalyst deactivates and flow passages block, causing pressure rise and maldistribution. Stack damage and loss of power follow.
recommendations: Install separate water and natural gas flow measurement with steam-to-carbon ratio control and a low-ratio trip

clusters.deviation: Other than Composition | Feed (sulphur/contaminants in natural gas)
clusters.causes: Desulphurisation upstream fails or is saturated, or the NG supply is off-spec
clusters.consequences: Sulphur poisons the reformer catalyst and Ni anode, causing progressive voltage loss and stack degradation.
recommendations: Provide sulphur breakthrough monitoring/periodic analysis downstream of the desulphuriser

clusters.deviation: Other than Flow | Stack external leak
clusters.causes: Wet seal degradation, corrosion, thermal cycling or ship motion/vibration
clusters.consequences: H2/CO released into the fuel cell room causes fire/explosion and toxic CO exposure to crew.
recommendations: Provide H2 and CO gas detection in the stack enclosure with ESD isolating LCV-100/LCV-300
Provide mechanical ventilation of the enclosure with monitoring per class rules

clusters.deviation: Other than Operation | Stack start-up
clusters.causes: H2 BOG or feed is admitted before the stack is purged or brought up to temperature, or the start-up sequence is done in the wrong order
clusters.consequences: A flammable mixture forms in the stack and ducts and can explode. Thermal shock and gas crossover follow if the electrolyte is not yet molten. Multiple fatalities are possible in an enclosed machinery space.
recommendations: Implement start-up permissives (purge complete, stack temperature above electrolyte melting point) before LCV-100/LCV-300 can open
Provide written start-up/shutdown procedures and operator training

clusters.deviation: Other than Phase | Feed (liquid water carry-over)
clusters.causes: Upstream vaporiser/heat exchanger failure lets liquid water reach the stack inlet
clusters.consequences: Liquid water hits the 650 °C reformer, causing thermal shock, cracking of catalyst/plates and local quenching of cells.
recommendations: Add low feed temperature alarm/trip on TE-100 to close LCV-100

clusters.deviation: Other than Power | Cell voltage deviation
clusters.causes: Individual cell degradation, local fuel starvation or flow maldistribution
clusters.consequences: Weak cells reverse, causing local hot spots, electrolyte loss and possible seal failure leading to a gas leak.
recommendations: Provide automatic load reduction on high cell voltage deviation

clusters.deviation: Part of Composition | Feed (natural gas + water) to reformer
clusters.causes: Water pump failure or low water flow gives a low steam-to-carbon ratio
clusters.consequences: Carbon deposits in the reformer and anode. The catalyst deactivates, flow paths block and pressure drop rises, causing performance loss and stack damage
recommendations: Measure water and natural gas flows separately, with a low steam-to-carbon ratio alarm and natural gas cut-off

clusters.deviation: Part of Composition | Stack containment (external leak)
clusters.causes: Seal, gasket or flange failure at the stack or its inlet/outlet piping from thermal cycling, ship motion or corrosion
clusters.consequences: Hot H2/CO-rich gas is released into the machinery space, with jet fire or explosion and CO poisoning of crew. Multiple fatalities are possible.
recommendations: Install H2 and CO gas detection in the stack enclosure with an ESD (SIL 2) that closes LCV-100/200/300
Provide a ventilated stack enclosure per the IGF Code
Set up an inspection programme for seals and flanges

clusters.deviation: Reverse Flow | Anode Out / Cathode Out
clusters.causes: Stack pressure drops during shutdown/trip while the downstream header remains pressurised, or BV-400/BV-410 is passing
clusters.consequences: Air/exhaust enters the anode, oxidising the Ni anode. A flammable mixture may form inside the stack.
recommendations: Install non-return valves on anode and cathode outlets
Provide inert gas purge on shutdown

clusters.deviation: Reverse Flow | H2 BOG / Feed inlet lines
clusters.causes: Supply pressure in the H2 BOG or feed line drops below stack pressure, for example on a compressor trip
clusters.consequences: Hot reformed gas (H2, CO) flows back into the upstream lines and compressors. This can overheat equipment, mix gas into another system, and expose people to toxic CO
recommendations: Install check valves on the feed and H2 BOG inlet lines
Close LCV-100 / LCV-300 on low supply pressure

clusters.deviation: Reverse Flow | Vent Out / Cathode Out into stack (correction to row 16)
clusters.causes: BV-160 opens (fail-open on utility loss or shutdown) or BV-410 is open while stack pressure decays after a trip, so air or exhaust flows back from Vent Out / Cathode Out into the cathode outlet line
clusters.consequences: Air enters the cathode outlet line, which also carries anode exhaust routed internally from the anode to the cathode. Air can then migrate through the internal anode-to-cathode path into the anode while residual H2/CO is still present. A flammable mixture can form at about 650 °C, with internal deflagration and stack damage, and the Ni anode oxidises. (Row 16 wrongly says air enters the anode directly.)
safeguards: BV-400 / BV-410 fail-closed on utility loss
recommendations: Provide an inert gas (N2) purge of the anode and cathode on shutdown, before BV-160 vents to atmosphere
Install a check valve or flame arrester on the Vent Out line downstream of BV-160 / PSV-160
Review the shutdown sequence so the stack is not left open to Vent Out / Cathode Out while unpurged

clusters.deviation: Reverse Flow | Vent line into stack
clusters.causes: BV-160 opens on shutdown or utility failure while stack pressure is low, letting air back in from Vent Out
clusters.consequences: Air enters the anode side. A flammable H2/air mixture forms at high temperature and can explode inside the stack. The Ni anode oxidises.
recommendations: Provide an inert gas (N2) purge of the anode on shutdown
Install a check valve or flame arrester on the vent line

clusters.deviation: Reverse Power | DC-Power output
clusters.causes: Back-feed from battery/other parallel modules into a weak or tripped stack
clusters.consequences: Cells are driven in reverse (electrolysis), causing anode/cathode corrosion and stack damage.
recommendations: Provide blocking diode/reverse current protection on DC output
